title: bip39-recovery — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the END-TO-END recovery composition protocol::phrase::normalize_user_phrase (§7.4) -> protocol::derive_recovery_wrap_key_from_normalized (§3.1): a raw user-typed 24-word phrase is NFKD-normalized then fed DIRECTLY to Argon2id (NOT through BIP-39's PBKDF2 step). Composes the existing phrase_normalize + argon2id category pipelines into one vector. The defining property: distinct raw inputs that normalize to the same phrase MUST derive the same recovery_wrap_key — this is what pins the NFKD-before-Argon2id ordering. Argon2id at canonical Phase 1 params (m=256 MiB, t=3, p=2, v=0x13) — ~3s per case. Spec contract: docs/spec/protocol.md §3.1 (recovery KDF) + §7.4 (phrase normalization).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'bip39-recovery/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_raw_phrase_utf8_hex.description: The raw user-typed recovery phrase as UTF-8 bytes (hex). May carry mixed case, padding/irregular whitespace, and NFKD-foldable characters (full-width Latin, no-break / ideographic spaces). A port runs its normalize_user_phrase equivalent over these bytes before deriving.

input_salt_random_hex.description: 16-byte random salt component (salt_random) for the recovery Argon2id derivation.

input_account_number_hash_hex.description: 16-byte account_number_hash bound into the recovery salt domain.

m_kib.description: Argon2id memory cost in KiB (262144 = 256 MiB at canonical v0.1 params).

t.description: Argon2id time cost (iterations); 3 at canonical params.

informational_normalized_phrase_utf8_hex.description: The normalized phrase bytes (output of normalize_user_phrase) that are fed to Argon2id. Informational — a port computes it itself — but pinned so the NFKD/lowercase/whitespace folding is auditable. Across all three cases this value is IDENTICAL (the raw inputs differ only in foldable presentation).

expected_recovery_wrap_key_hex.description: The 32-byte recovery_wrap_key. IDENTICAL across all cases in a set whose raw phrases normalize to the same string — the cross-impl invariant a port must reproduce.
